serverUrl.title: MCP Server URL
serverUrl.description: Full URL of the MCP server's Streamable HTTP endpoint (e.g. https://example.com/mcp).

authHeader.title: Authorization header (optional)
authHeader.description: If the server requires auth to list tools, provide it here (e.g. 'Bearer sk-...'). Leave empty to also test the server's unauthenticated behavior.

runDynamicChecks.title: Run dynamic checks
runDynamicChecks.description: If enabled, the scanner will make live test calls to the server (SSRF probes, malformed input, auth bypass attempts) in addition to static schema analysis. Disable for a read-only, schema-only scan.

maxToolsToTest.title: Max tools to dynamically test
maxToolsToTest.description: Caps how many exposed tools get live dynamic testing, to control scan time and load on the target server.
